plainEnglish.summary: An organisational assertion: the organisation states that it has a process and policy for reviewing written content for clear structure before publication - checking the Structure guideline's core requirements, keeping sections concise, considering icons as structural cues, and turning sentences into lists where that helps - and that any style guide or author training covers these.
plainEnglish.whyItMatters: Structure is decided while writing, not afterwards. A review process is what keeps clear structure from depending on which author happened to write the page.
